title: The mean phosphorus share in three high-flow months was below nitrate in combined Gulf river estimates for 1980-2025
abstract: We tested nutrient load shares in the three highest-flow months of each water year in fixed USGS estimates for the Mississippi and Atchafalaya outlets. In 1980-2025, the combined mean total phosphorus share was 39.685%, below the nitrate plus nitrite share of 41.909%. The paired difference was -2.224 percentage points. The conditional 95% three-year block interval was -3.179 to -1.282. Mississippi had a negative difference; Atchafalaya had no clear difference. The combined difference changed by +0.750 points between 1980-2002 and 2003-2025, with an interval of -1.062 to +2.605. This gives no clear period change. The point gap can be erased by deliberately opposed temporal load errors of 2.33%. Year resampling excludes source-model error. Thus this is a result about a fixed load product, not secure evidence of a physical transport difference. Monthly aggregation, two selected outlets, model dependence and season limit use. Code, monthly evidence, source hashes, an audit, results and a figure permit reproduction.
